sections.content: Attributes configure elements: href on links, src on images, class and id for CSS/JS hooks, style for inline CSS.
Global attributes work on every element: class (shared styling), id (unique identifier), title (tooltip), data-* (custom data), hidden, lang.
Key points: attribute values go in quotes, class can hold multiple space-separated names, and id must be unique per page.
